text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, a Classic race 
you can only run once in a lifetime—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It brings back so many emotions. To think 
I'd be standing on the Classic stage.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It is the dream of every Umamusume, where 
the strongest clash after racing all this 
way for the ultimate honor—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you think everything's in 
place? All the conditions for me to put on 
an overwhelming performance♪
choice_data_list:
Let's show everyone a back worth looking 
up to!

Let's show everyone a back worth looking 
up to!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll blaze through with my engine at 
full throttle!

Chasing after the admirable back that 
everyone yearns to follow, the gates for 
the Satsuki Sho are finally opening...!
